summary: Completed testing of 2FA enforcement feature. All 6 backend API tests pass. All 5 frontend UI tests pass. Feature working correctly: dialog appears after login, skip button works, skip count updates correctly, mandatory 2FA shows after 3 skips.

backend.test_login_returns_totp_skip_count: PASS - Login response includes totp_skip_count field
backend.test_skip_returns_remaining_count: PASS - Skip response returns correct skips_remaining
backend.test_max_skips_returns_400: PASS - 4th skip returns 400 with 'Maximum skips reached' message

frontend.dialog_appears_after_login: PASS - 2FA enforcement dialog appears after login for user without 2FA
frontend.dialog_shows_secure_title: PASS - Dialog shows 'Secure your account' title with description
frontend.dialog_has_setup_button: PASS - 'Set up 2FA now' button present with data-testid='2fa-setup-btn'
frontend.dialog_has_skip_button: PASS - 'Skip for now (3 times remaining)' button present with data-testid='2fa-skip-btn'
frontend.skip_closes_dialog: PASS - Clicking skip closes dialog and user can access app
frontend.skip_count_updates: PASS - After first skip, second login shows '2 times remaining'
frontend.setup_button_opens_setup: PASS - Clicking 'Set up 2FA now' opens TwoFactorSetup component dialog
frontend.mandatory_mode_no_skip: PASS - After 3 skips, dialog shows 'Two-factor authentication required' with no skip button

critical_code_review_comments: TwoFactorEnforcement component correctly uses user.totp_skip_count to determine UI state
onPointerDownOutside and onEscapeKeyDown prevent accidental dialog dismissal
Skip API correctly returns 400 when max skips (3) reached
Login response includes totp_skip_count for immediate UI display
TwoFactorEnforcementWrapper in App.js properly resets dismissed state on user change
context_for_next_testing_agent: 2FA enforcement feature fully tested and working. Feature shows dialog on login when user.totp_enabled=false. Users can skip up to 3 times (MAX_SKIPS=3). After 3 skips, dialog shows mandatory mode with no skip button. Skip count is stored in totp_skip_count field and persists across sessions. Test user (admkoodh@koodh.com) has totp_skip_count reset to 0 after testing.
